title: Bilinear correlations in Fluctuating Gaussian States with anti-unitary symmetries
summary: We study bilinear order-parameter correlations in a general class of sign problem-free systems that are described by what we call Fluctuating Gaussian States (FGS) with anti-unitary symmetries, where the weight of each Gaussian measurement in the space-time path integral is positive-definite.
